name: Rebuild model site on release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

        run: |
          echo "Triggering Vercel deploy hook..."
          curl -X POST ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}

          MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}

name: Rebuild model site on release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel deploy hook

          echo "Triggering Vercel deploy hook..."

          MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}
